description: This PHP class defines a REST API controller for managing database configuration during an installation or upgrade process, including handling GET and POST requests to retrieve and store database connection details, and validate the connection.

classes.name: DatabaseConfigAPI
classes.description: A REST controller handling GET and POST requests for database configuration during an upgrade process, including validation and retrieval of database connection info.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to save database connection details and validate connection, returning success data or error message.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve stored database configuration details.
